## Trigger Conditions
This error is returned by the contract when:
- `PolicyNoPendingHandoff` validation fails during entrypoint invocation.


---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Ask the current policy admin to call policy_propose_handoff before calling policy_accept_handoff.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let admin = Address::generate(&f.env);
f.client.mock_all_auths().policy_init(&admin);
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_policy_accept_handoff());
```
